# Environment Setup {#sec-setup}

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon="false"}
**Appendix status: skeleton.**
:::

Everything in this book runs in one of two places:

- **Your browser.** All interactive widgets are self-contained — nothing to
  install.
- **A Python environment.** Executable chapters use Python ≥ 3.11 with a
  short dependency list.

## Local setup

```bash
python -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate
pip install numpy matplotlib jupyter
```

<!-- TODO: pin exact versions once notebooks stabilize; add uv-based

## Colab

Every executable chapter links its notebook with an *Open in Colab* badge —
zero local setup, free GPU when a chapter needs one (none of Part I–II do).

## Getting help

Open a GitHub issue with the chapter name in the title, or use the comment
box at the bottom of any page.
